references.text: John the Baptist sends his disciples to Jesus to ask if He is the one who was to come, which shows John's significant role and recognition.
Herod wants to kill John but fears the crowd because they regard him as a prophet, highlighting John's high status and Herod's fear.
Herod imprisons John for rebuking him concerning Herodias, but it is also noted that Herod feared John, which parallels his fear and respect shown in Mark 6:20.
